reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (京准通 营销API + 数据报表API on the JD Open Platform) Confidence: **high** — official opendoc.jd.com GitBook read.
auth: 1. Register a developer account + application on the 京东开放平台 (jos.jd.com, 宙斯开发者中心); follow 入驻流程指导 to get the ads API category approved.
2. Advertiser (or agency, with 代理子PIN) authorizes the app → `access_token`; requests are signed with `app_key` / `app_secret`, `timestamp`, `v`, `method`, `360buy_param_json`.
3. Account hierarchy: 账户体系 with agency sub-PINs, 跟单 info, sub-accounts.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: app_key of the JOS (京东宙斯) application approved for the 京准通 API permission package (https://opendoc.jd.com/ads_api/jzt/api/word/settle.html).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: appSecret of that application; never sent, used for the MD5 request signature.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: OAuth access_token of the 京准通 PIN that authorised the app (https://jos.jd.com/commondoc?listId=32); renew it through the JOS authorisation flow when it expires.

adapter.terms: 京东 JOS gateway (API调用, https://jos.jd.com/commondoc?listId=33): every call goes to https://api.jd.com/routerjson with method, app_key, access_token, timestamp ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', within 6 minutes of server time), v=2.0 and the business parameters as one JSON string in 360buy_param_json; sign = MD5(appSecret + sorted key/value pairs + appSecret) in upper case, 'value无需编码'. Gateway failures answer {error_response: {code, zh_desc, en_desc}}; 京准通 results carry {code: "1", success, msg}. Access needs a 京准通 PIN, an approved app and permission package 1802.

me.note: No profile call is documented for the 京准通 API; the probe lists one 搜索快车 campaign (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.list.v2, pageSize 1).

list_campaigns.note: 查询普通计划列表 (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.list.v2): 京东搜索快车 campaigns (普通快车商品计划, 腰带店铺计划, 门店商品计划) with today's metrics (startDay = endDay = today, clickOrOrderDay 0, click caliber, gifts excluded). Each row is {item: {campaignId, campaignName, campaignType, status (1 暂停, 2 启动, 3 预算用完, 4 不在投放时间段), budget (a string, left in raw), cost, clicks, impressions, CTR, CPC, totalOrderSum, totalOrderROI, …}}. account_id and status are not sent (the access_token's PIN selects the account).

update_budget.note: 修改预算 (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.updatebudget.v2, data {id, dayBudget}) sets the daily budget in 元 of one 搜索快车 campaign. This spends money. The 京准通 result {code, success, msg} comes back inside a successful gateway response (success = false when it was rejected). currency is ignored (CNY).

pause_resume.note: 修改状态 (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.updatestatus.v2, data {ids: [campaign_id], operateType}) with pause → 1 (暂停) and resume → 2 (启动). success = false in the result means the platform rejected it. Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: The 京准通 API acts for the PIN that authorised the access_token; the only account-listing calls are for agencies and sub-accounts ('查询代理子PIN列表', '查询子账号列表' under 账户管理, https://opendoc.jd.com/ads_api/jzt/), not the advertiser's own ad accounts.
not_offered.get_report: The cross-channel 自定义报表 (jingdong.ads.ibg.UniversalJosService.custom.query.v2, https://opendoc.jd.com/ads_api/jzt/api/word/report/datacenter/custom/query.html) is in gray release: '当前为灰度发布阶段，如需使用，请发送邮件至org.ads.api1@jd.com申请'; list_campaigns already returns today's cost, clicks, impressions and orders per campaign.
